# Evening Update — Thursday, 15 October 2026

**Since this morning:** Piyush Goyal announced the **first phase of the India-US trade deal is finalised**, while US markets absorbed a **hot 6.3% wholesale inflation** surge that triggered an AI-to-value rotation.

## 🌆 What changed since this morning?

✅ CONFIRMED **UPDATE** — **India and US finalise first phase of bilateral trade pact** — Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal confirmed that the **first tranche of the trade pact is finalised** and is now undergoing **formal legal drafting** [[Times of India]](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/us-trade-deal-finalised-legal-drafting-on-piyush-goyal/articleshow/134976975.cms) [[Daily Pioneer]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Deccan Herald]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxNV2p5djZ4REJjc0tWMWhMWDFpSVRBS3NRMmpXZ2JrYmVVaUFDUGlhczhPWVJVSWRud19HMHp0SEhFWl95RS14WlkyeUt4NzRLRkhlX2lUeWRVLTdnLUM3UVoyckMwZ194Zmk1TFA5aGg5VUhkbjRSRmRuVVJwd1Z6alVmMURieFJ1akFhNlpuQUxPcm9kWjl5X3ZHMDc0MVJEV1lsMThIMWVjWmhrLVdKYjNUWEdnNEVsS0pvclV1Vloydw?oc=5). Previously, both nations were negotiating key tariff terms. This moves mutual tariff cuts on selected export lines directly into the text-drafting stage before signing.

✅ CONFIRMED **NEW** — **US wholesale inflation surges 6.3% in September** — The US **Producer Price Index (PPI) surged 6.3%** year-over-year in September, marking its fastest pace since 2022 and outpacing expectations [[AP News]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxQNExzSHEyWDFGWnpSTkR2V3NndkhQTmU1dzE3M2pTWENyU3RPRTAyb0JQQXNqbENPTjJneHRsYWpMMXFPUXg3dnZfekhEM1VoSFNIRTM4U29QR1l0TGhzeVd6WkZIamdXWDkwcmdlR3k5eExLZFd3SUc0MHFQc1NoQlIwRWw5MzM5OVpndWJKa3NIZFNJRGx5YQ?oc=5) [[Analytics Insight]](https://news.google.?oc=5). The jump was driven by energy and logistics costs. This keeps **Federal Reserve interest rate hike risks** alive and signals persistent consumer price pressure.

⚖️ COURT DEVELOPMENT **NEW** — **Eight US states sue OpenAI alleging child safety harms** — A bipartisan group of **eight state attorneys general sued OpenAI** in state courts [[The Washington Post]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[Al Jazeera]](https://news.google.?oc=5) [[CNN]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxOLUxrZkpCSlViTi1lNHlYamR4WUo5UUoxVG1yb0EwVFBuX0tkRWZDMWVmQzloNDNIX2JNVzA2SFVsTDktay1FSkJmRXRxTHZYck9WOEs0WWtDek5qR1p1ZTdKMS0zU3J0Ynl1OU5pQ0ZzS0dNMTdlVlExRTJUT29EVDZoZWpZZw?oc=5). The lawsuits allege ChatGPT **harms minors and deceives consumers**, opening a major new front of state-level consumer protection enforcement against AI labs.

⚖️ COURT DEVELOPMENT **NEW** — **Supreme Court quashes Yes Bank $880M AT-1 bond write-off** — India’s **Supreme Court invalidated Yes Bank's ₹8,400 crore ($880 million) AT-1 bond write-off**, observing that the Reserve Bank of India acted as a "mere bystander" during previous management irregularities [[Live Law]](https://news.google.?oc=5). Following the decision, **Kotak Mutual Fund suspended fresh subscriptions** in two debt funds exposed to the bonds [[Outlook Business]](https://news.google.?oc=5).

🟡 DEVELOPING **NEW** — **Anthropic faces IPO valuation pushback and municipal pause call** — Prospective investors are **pushing Anthropic to lower its IPO valuation** toward $1.5 trillion due to slowing sequential growth [[Reuters]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixAFBVV95cUxQRW4tSGppV2U0ZWtvaXBsQmlyaDVVLVFCSmJNMWdmMHpod0FWd25kUXRNQzFvZXJPTmhoQUNvMlFrQzI3NjBQVG9McWFPRHdUODhMbVItOGg4S0N3ZmJ4R2psZVd1aWFZM2M0aEY4R3VaYnFZWUxhOFZiRXAxTnc5UG9hMm1ERGpKbURkX3BWYzQ5UWl3THBFTDhWUWR0SVhUSWJsekpMZjM4OUZRQl9BVmY2djVKRENDSldCSUpOWmdvbHVK?oc=5) [[Yahoo Finance]](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxQZHp0a2hZLU9LOWNLUGVQMDExYjk1TklpMWstVFZmUTdzZzhSblpZcF8wY3RiUTZKYklmOU02UnpxNHkwUGVwcHE4N2p3c2w5dUJRd1Bwblp1bkhNLUVYTkhpNGVTakRwcmd0ZVV1ajVzV3Y2YlZOenM2SXBDRXhzT3FvclBwVXZkUldneVVQU0FkdEdJa19QTFBXU3g?oc=5).
